plan.angle: The top 10 for music quiz is all quizzes to take: Sporcle, Mental Floss, BuzzFeed, Muzify, songquiz.io, a SongPop app, a Spotify playlist, a YouTube channel and Carnegie Hall's quizzes for kids. None shows how to run a music quiz as your own app, with your own questions, scoring and a table of who missed what. This page gives the searcher both: an 8-question music quiz on notation, instruments and composers to play on the page, each answer sourced, then four music quizzes a school music teacher, a taproom trivia night, a piano studio and a community radio station run as their own app.
tab_stories: Pell Ridge Middle School's 3 seventh-grade general music classes, 81 students in all, take a 12-question instrument families quiz, and the French horn question, missed by 38 of 81, goes back on the board before the concert unit.

The Owl and Anchor's Thursday trivia runs a 10-question 90s music round for 12 teams answering on their phones, a 1997 one-hit wonder question stumps 10 of the 12, and The Mixtapes win the round with 9 of 10.

Linden Lane Piano Studio sends its 26 students an 8-question theory quiz every week, the teacher gets a Sunday email listing the 4 students under 5 of 8, and key signatures get a second pass in their next lessons.

Marsh Hollow Community Radio posts a 10-question Friday music quiz on its website, 530 listeners take it, a Slack recap names the hardest question, missed by 371 of 530, and Monday's morning show opens on it.
